sections.Profile:
"Sun Valley" is a two-player electro-mechanical pinball machine released by Chicago Coin Machine Manufacturing Company in October 1962. The game features two flippers, three pop bumpers, and two kick-out holes.

- Manufacturer: Chicago Coin Machine Mfg. Co.
- Years made: 1962
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 2
- Tags: Two player, Travel, Vacation, Sports, Original Theme, Skiing, Winter
